text:
sara: FYI after merging cust-pegasus LoRA into staging our invoice smoketest on int4 started dropping negative signs on refunds (pred shows positive amount). quick repro below.

ben: ugh, that's bad. paste the minimal lines.

sara: run: python eval_pack/run_smoke.py --model pegasus-lora-int4 --dataset samples/invoices/refunds.jsonl --metrics signed_amount_match
output snippet:
{"id":"r-100","pred":"$25.00","gold":"-$25.00"}
{"id":"r-101","pred":"$0.00","gold":"-$0.00"}
{"id":"r-102","pred":"-$12.00","gold":"-$12.00"}

jorge: interesting that some negatives survive. looks like edge cases on parentheses vs minus sign. any tokenizer changes?

sara: none in the MR. LoRA only. fp16 baseline matches gold perfectly. int4 shows sign-loss for entries where original had leading minus sign separated by a non-breaking space in source.

ben: could be decode or quantized logits shifting preference between '-' token and whitespace token. can you try two quick ablations: (A) int4 forcing legacy attn kernel, (B) int4 with decode fallback to standard (no fused decode)?

bench-bot: scheduled job qb-4312345678-ablation [cust-pegasus,refund-sign-loss], ETA 6m

sara: ablation results: (A) legacy attn kernel -> sign preserved on repro set. (B) standard decode -> also preserves sign.

jorge: that points to quantized attention + fused decode interaction nudging whitespace token higher probability than '-' in some contexts.

ben: short-term plan: pin pegassus customer rollout to legacy attn+standard decode on Dedicated, add a signed-amount unit to quick-eval that asserts presence of leading '-' when gold is negative, and block canary until that test passes.

qa-bot: blocking deploy: "signed-amount-regression" check failed for repo redwood/cust-pegasus -> manual approval required.

sara: opened MR updating quick-eval and onboarding note: https://git.internal/redwood/cust-pegasus/merge-requests/21. assigned to @jorge for kernel triage.

bench-bot: job qb-4312345678-ablation finished: artifacts at /artifacts/qb-4312345678 (summary: legacy attn & standard decode remove sign-loss on sample set).

jorge: I'll reproduce locally and dump attention logits for spans around numeric-sign tokens and surrounding whitespace, then file a kernel/decode issue if reproducible. ETA ~3h. posting findings back here.

ben: thanks. also add a small normalization step in eval matcher to accept -0.00 vs $0.00 equivalence until kernel fix is in, but keep the failing test so we fail on regressions.

sara: done, PR updated. thanks everyone for quick triage. :thumbsup:
